findings.summary: Independently rechecked all 20 quantitative observations against their labeled FDA IFU locators. All 12 SAPIEN 3 values match S085 PDF page 2, Table 2; all eight Evolut FX annulus/profile values match S174 PDF pages 32–35, Table 2/Figure 2/Table 3. Evolut 23 mm correctly excludes the 17 mm SAV/TAV-only footnote exception. Records remain unreviewed; that status should be retained until review is recorded.

The local provenance identifies an FDA drawing for SAPIEN 3 Ultra model 9750TFX with ThermaFix-treated tissue, not the SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA generation. Existing caption claim that the RESILIA model differs only by tissue treatment is unsupported and conflicts with FDA/manufacturer product material; qualify this as a platform-reference image or replace it with exact RESILIA-specific evidence.

The LAmbre article and the two Frontiers figure sources state CC BY reuse terms. Figure 1 of the Reducer article and Figure 4A of the Corvia article are identified without the Elsevier-permission warning that applies to Figure 3. Existing captions record CC BY but lack complete source/author attribution, license links, and crop notices. CC BY 4.0 requires appropriate credit, a license link, and indication of changes.

Explicitly absent, ongoing, or not-yet-reported outcomes and endpoint fields remain unknown, not zero; this audit did not replace missing outcomes or infer endpoint results from registry status. Preserve those missingness states pending primary-source readout.

Primary/official source checks support these trial records: evidence-champion-af (parent prior NEJM check), evidence-protect-af, evidence-amulet-ide, evidence-swiss-apero, evidence-veritas, evidence-watchman-flx-pas, evidence-atriclip-exclude, evidence-triluminate, evidence-predict, evidence-vital, evidence-pvl-pld-multicenter, evidence-rechord, evidence-michord-pilot, evidence-alive, evidence-peerless-hf, evidence-acorn-five-year, evidence-momentum-3, evidence-kiss-pvl, evidence-tricento-registry. Study-specific cohort/generation limitations are retained in the audit report.

Current ClinicalTrials.gov status/enrollment details were not independently confirmed from a usable official record in this pass for evidence-tricaval and evidence-corcinch-hf. The TRICAVAL primary publication verifies the randomized study and stop for valve dislocations/safety; official registry status/enrollment needs refresh. CORCINCH-HF mirrors report suspension, but its official current record needs refresh. Keep date-specific current registry detail as a gap; suspension does not establish product withdrawal.

Enumerated and source-checked all 19 readouts: readout-acorn-corcap-5y, readout-kiss-pvl-2024, readout-michord-fda, readout-tricento-registry, readout-alive-12m, readout-momentum3-5y, readout-champion-af-3y, readout-protect-af-primary, readout-amulet-ide-18m, readout-amulet-ide-5y, readout-watchman-flx-pas-2y, readout-swiss-apero-3y, readout-veritas-45d, readout-atriclip-exclude, readout-tri-350-1y, readout-tri-572-1y, readout-tri-572-2y, readout-predict-90d, readout-vital-6m. VERITAS original indexed abstract and Abbott source establish 0 mm complete closure versus ≤5 mm primary effectiveness definitions, denominator and timing; full text is inaccessible, but abstract facts are directly verified.

Numerically rechecked against primary tables/figures/source text all 27 outcomes: outcome-acorn-lvedv-5y, outcome-kiss-pvl-procedural-success, outcome-michord-recurrent-mr-1y, outcome-tricento-technical-success, outcome-alive-primary-12m, outcome-momentum3-survival-5y, outcome-champion-efficacy-3y, outcome-champion-bleeding-3y, outcome-protect-af-primary, outcome-amulet-safety-12m, outcome-amulet-effectiveness-18m, outcome-amulet-closure-45d, outcome-amulet-effectiveness-5y, outcome-watchman-flx-pas-stroke-se-2y, outcome-swiss-apero-3y-ischemic, outcome-veritas-safety-7d, outcome-veritas-closure-45d, outcome-atriclip-intraop-exclusion, outcome-atriclip-3m-exclusion, outcome-tri-350-hierarchy, outcome-tri-572-hierarchy, outcome-tri-572-hfh-1y, outcome-tri-572-hfh-2y, outcome-tri-572-death-2y, outcome-predict-primary, outcome-predict-closure, outcome-vital-score. The two VERITAS outcomes are supported by the original indexed abstract: 0/400 primary safety events through 7 days/discharge; 376/376 met ≤5 mm at 45 days; 93.9% had 0 mm complete closure.

The publisher-indexed original abstract verifies zero primary-safety events among 400 through 7 days/discharge, primary effectiveness defined as ≤5 mm at 45-day TEE among 376 evaluable patients (all met it), and complete closure defined as 0 mm leak in 93.9%. Abbott separately describes the 93.9% as no leaks greater than 3 mm; this is compatible with the stricter 0 mm primary-paper definition. The publisher page itself was inaccessible, so claims beyond the indexed abstract remain unverified.

Abbott Navitor IFU terminology is consistent: the current US IFU describes NaviSeal inner/outer cuff portions as polyethylene; Abbott product-materials IFU calls the cuff a polyethylene fabric and specifies UHMWPE in its substance table on PDF p.13. Recommend parent normalize as UHMWPE (polyethylene) cuff fabric, retaining exact permanent implant scope.
